result.title: Interactive Person Retrieval with On-the-Fly Visual Feedback
result.summary: Traditional text-based person retrieval (TPR) assumes that a witness provides a complete description at once, whereas interactive person retrieval (Inter-PR) refines a partial description through question-answer exchanges. In this setting, the questioner inspects retrieved candidates to decide what evidence to request next, while the answerer sees only the witness-side memory and cannot report candidate-specific visual differences. Existing methods mainly learn offline question orderings, leaving this visual-feedback loop underexplored. To address this limitation, we introduce visual-feedback interactive person retrieval (VFI-PR), a new interactive retrieval paradigm in which retrieved candidates produce visual feedback that becomes evidence for subsequent questioning and re-ranking. To support training and evaluation in this setting, we construct VFI-PEDES, a dataset and evaluation protocol for visual-feedback interaction, and propose VFI-ReID, a framework that learns to use visual feedback during interactive person retrieval. Through the Dynamic Accumulated-evidence Retriever (DAR) and retrieval-aware question optimization, VFI-ReID adapts retrieval and question generation to evolving evidence states, turning visual feedback into complementary evidence for subsequent retrieval. Experiments show that VFI-ReID consistently improves retrieval across VFI-PR interaction stages, demonstrating the utility of visual feedback for interactive person retrieval and outperforming existing Inter-PR baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出视觉反馈交互式行人检索范式 VFI-PR 及配套数据集与评测协议 VFI-PEDES，并给出 VFI-ReID 框架，通过动态累积证据检索器与检索感知的提问优化，把检索候选产生的视觉反馈作为后续提问与重排序的补充证据。
AI.relevance_reason: 「查看候选—决定下一步取证—累积证据状态」的交互闭环，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、推理状态更新与何时停止取证相类比；但其证据状态如何表示、训练监督如何分配尚需核查。
